description: This PHP source file defines the Api controller class for startup API handling in the OpenCart framework. It manages API request validation, access control, and logging.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: Controller class for handling startup API requests, validating access, and managing API permissions within the OpenCart framework.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that validates API requests, checks permissions, IP whitelisting, and signature verification before allowing API call execution.

methods.name: permission
methods.description: Handles cases where API permission is denied, outputting a 403 Forbidden response with an error message.
